intro: Written by the reviewer for the run of 2026-09-21 against cc1c8de, from each agent's diff, its report and its transcript; every cell has a line in one of those. These are the judgements no script derives: how the graph was shaped and what the agent made of the checker, whether the report says what the prompt asked, whether the tree was left as asked. Green is what the tree wanted, amber is defensible but incomplete, red is wrong. render.py shows this table only while the run it speaks of is the run on the page; after a rerun, rewrite it or delete it.
